messages:
maria: Kicking off micro staged rollout to 12% now (deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-12). Window 12:00-13:00 UTC. Dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23-12 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started 1: deploy-2026-03-23-12 at 12:03 UTC. Target 12% split across primary regions. Auto-lift disabled. Logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23-12

chen: eyeballing metrics 12:06 UTC  p50 fine but embed p99 jumped 2x and a small error bump on long-seq requests. https://dash.re/metrics/embeddings

maria: hold any further increases. @oric can you run a quick infra scan?

oric: infra quick-check: no node restarts, CPU steady. KV cache eviction spiked on a minority of pods that handled long-history traffic. Evictions 1/min -> 80/min.

sanjay: that pattern matches the tokenizer change we merged yesterday. Could be cache growth from new token offsets.

chen: vote: rollback regionally to v2.3.1 for long-seq traffic, keep other traffic on new build. Minimizes churn.

oric: vote: pause and slice-route long-history clients to v2.3.1 until we confirm.

maria: consensus for a slice fallback. @deploy-bot prepare reroute and pin commands.

deploy-bot: actions: `pause`, `reroute --selector <expr> --to-version <tag>`, `rollback --to <tag>`, `pin --version <tag>`. Run `/deploy action <action>` to act.

maria: executing: `/deploy reroute --selector "client.history>1000" --to-version v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-12 --reason "kv-eviction spike for long-seq traffic"`

deploy-bot: reroute applied. Traffic matching selector now routed to v2.3.1. Monitoring for 5m.

chen: immediate reduction in embed p99 and 5xxs for the long-history slice. Nice.

sanjay: infra confirms evictions returning to baseline on affected pods. Will open INC-2026-146 to track tokenizer offsets and add regression.

maria: pinning v2.3.1 for selector slice for the change window: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --selector "client.history>1000"`

deploy-bot: pinned v2.3.1 for selected slice until 2026-03-23T13:00:00Z. Incident INC-2026-146 created and linked.

oric: follow-ups: add a perf test for long-history tokenization and a KV-cache stress test.

maria: summary: micro-hold + targeted reroute to stable for long-history traffic, pinned slice during window. We'll revert the pin after fixes and retest. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
